title: I made a free AI to sprite art workflow tool
author: flavorfox
selftext:
Hi yall,

I made a little free workflow tool I'd like to share.

I've been frustrated with pixel art generation from ChatGPT etc - as most of you know it only fakes pixelart. I've been using sprite fusions pixel snapper tool, but I've been feeling it would benefit from some workflow improvements.

So I created a node based workflow tool that:

* Supports input as single images, folders, image sets or copy/pasted images.
* Supports cleaning up artifacts, removeing backgrounds, trimming transparent areas, removing outlines.
* Supports pixel snapping transforming it to real pixels.
* Supports palette mapping with extensive dithering support.
* Supports correct color-cell mapping for legacy C64, Spectrum etc. look,
* Supports scaling, content aware scaling, translations
* Supports splitting sets and images to custom sub graphs.
* Supports color grading and corrections.
* Supports joining images into output atlas.
* Supports saving pipelines

So besides transforming large pseudo-pixel art from Chat etc. into actual usable pixel art that may only need minor manual adjustments it also allows workflows such as creating shadow sprites from images, recoloring multiple variations etc:

I hope some of you find it useful, and yes, it's obviously done with AI.

[https://pixipipe.pages.dev/](https://pixipipe.pages.dev/)
